    Description

    Planet Zoo 2 is set to release on October 13, 2026, bringing its simulation magic to PC. Developed and published by Frontier Developments, this sequel aims to broaden your zoo management horizons. Not just another animal park sim, Planet Zoo 2 lets you create distinctive zoos worldwide with an even wider array of critters, including fully aquatic and flying species that add a new layer of complexity. What's really intriguing is the shift towards Wildlife Reserves, allowing players to release animals into open environments. It's where strategy meets conservation, within the juicy framework of intricate simulation gameplay.
